newsitem.title: UK: BFI down as Panamaxes weaken further.
newsitem.headline: BFI down as Panamaxes weaken further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down 13 on Thursday at 1,422 points and brokers said the decline was caused by significantly weaker Panamax fixtures in the Atlantic.

Hanjin fixed Oceanic Enterprise 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan Feb 4/14 at $23.80 no combo (down 15 cents from Wednesday's level) and Cobelfret fixed Dubrovnik for 55,000 heavy grain Mississippi to Ghent for early February at $12.00 (vessel believed to be waiting up to a week).

Also weaker were timecharter rates with Halla for example fixing Big Sky 69,189 dwt delivery USGulf early Feb for trip Far East at $13,200 daily plus $210,000 bonus (compared to Gortys yesterday at $13,500 plus $250,000 bonus).

The Baltic Handymax index was unchanged at 1,033 but the Gulf to Continent and Brazil to Continent grain routes (not included in the index) were down from $15.66 to $14.75 and $17.00 to $15.88 respectively.
